app.access

Route protection decorators for the Snip-Snap Flask application.

Provides login_required() and roles_required() which can be applied to any Flask view to enforce authentication and role-based access control using the Flask session.

app.access.current_role() → str | None[source]

Return the role string of the currently logged-in user, or None.

app.access.login_required(view: Callable)[source]

Decorator that redirects unauthenticated requests to the login page.

app.access.roles_required(*allowed_roles: str)[source]

Decorator factory that restricts a view to users with one of the given roles.

Parameters:

*allowed_roles – Role strings (e.g. "barber", "customer") that are permitted to access the decorated view.

Returns:

A decorator that returns 403 for authenticated users without the required role, or redirects to login for unauthenticated users.
